Class CodeModel

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.codemodel.CodeModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class CodeModel extends AnahataToolkit
Universal JVM Code Model toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA.

Provides clean-room, token-efficient programmatic navigation, member inspection, source extraction, and hierarchy traversal across all JVM languages supported by the IntelliJ Platform (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala) with deterministic location-based disambiguation for conflicting FQNs.

Author:
anahata

    • findTypes

      public Page<TypeItem> findTypes(String query, Boolean caseSensitive, Integer startIndex, Integer pageSize) throws AgiToolException
      Finds types matching a query across all JVM languages (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala) in open projects, library dependencies, and the IntelliJ Platform SDK/JDK using indexed caches.
      Parameters:
      query - the search query: simple class name, FQN, wildcard (*, ?), or camel-hump abbreviation.
      caseSensitive - whether the search should be case-sensitive. Defaults to false.
      startIndex - starting index (0-based) for pagination. Defaults to 0.
      pageSize - maximum number of results to return per page. Defaults to 50.
      Returns:
      a paginated result of TypeItem records.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if indexing is still in progress.

    • getMembers

      public MemberPage getMembers(String fqn, String location, String nameQuery, List<String> kindFilters, Boolean includeInherited, Integer startIndex, Integer pageSize) throws Exception
      Gets a paginated list of all members (methods, constructors, fields, properties, inner types) for a type across any JVM language.
      Parameters:
      fqn - the fully-qualified name of the type.
      location - optional origin location descriptor to disambiguate if multiple types share the same FQN.
      nameQuery - optional query string to filter members by name (case-insensitive substring match).
      kindFilters - optional list of member kinds to filter by (e.g. ['METHOD', 'FIELD']).
      includeInherited - whether to include inherited members from supertypes. Defaults to false.
      startIndex - starting index (0-based) for pagination. Defaults to 0.
      pageSize - maximum number of results to return per page. Defaults to 108.
      Returns:
      a MemberPage with enclosing type metadata and members.
      Throws:
      Exception - if resolution or member extraction fails.

    • getSource

      public String getSource(String targetFqn, String location) throws Exception
      Retrieves the source code declaration of a type OR a specific member across any JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala). Automatically navigates decompiled bytecode or attached library source files.
      Parameters:
      targetFqn - the fully-qualified name of the type OR canonical member FQN.
      location - optional origin location to disambiguate if multiple types share the same FQN.
      Returns:
      the raw source text.
      Throws:
      Exception - if resolution fails.

    • getHierarchy

      public HierarchyNode getHierarchy(String fqn, HierarchyDirection direction, String location, Integer maxDepth) throws Exception
      Recursively explores the type hierarchy tree (either SUBTYPES or SUPERTYPES) for a given type across any JVM language.
      Parameters:
      fqn - the fully-qualified name of the starting type.
      direction - the traversal direction: 'SUBTYPES' (subclasses and implementors) or 'SUPERTYPES' (base classes and interfaces).
      location - optional origin location to disambiguate if multiple types share the same FQN.
      maxDepth - maximum recursion depth. Defaults to 3.
      Returns:
      a clean, recursive HierarchyNode tree.
      Throws:
      Exception - if resolution fails.

    • loadSources

      public String loadSources(List<String> fqns, String location) throws Exception
      Loads the source files for one or more types as managed resources into the session context. Supports local project files and external library dependencies across all JVM languages.
      Parameters:
      fqns - list of fully-qualified type names to load into context.
      location - optional origin location to disambiguate if any FQN is ambiguous.
      Returns:
      summary message.
      Throws:
      Exception - if loading fails.

    • findTypesInPackage

      public Page<TypeItem> findTypesInPackage(String packageName, String kindFilter, Boolean recursive, String location, Integer startIndex, Integer pageSize) throws AgiToolException
      Finds all types within a package across any JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala), with an option for recursive search.
      Parameters:
      packageName - the fully-qualified name of the package.
      kindFilter - optional kind of type to filter by (CLASS, INTERFACE, ENUM, RECORD, ANNOTATION, OBJECT, TRAIT).
      recursive - if true, search includes all subpackages. Defaults to false.
      location - optional origin location to limit search to a specific module, SDK, or jar.
      startIndex - starting index (0-based) for pagination. Defaults to 0.
      pageSize - maximum number of results to return per page. Defaults to 50.
      Returns:
      paginated Page of TypeItems.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if indexing is in progress.

    • collectTypesInPackage

      private void collectTypesInPackage(com.intellij.psi.PsiPackage pkg, com.intellij.openapi.project.Project project, boolean recursive, String filterKindUpper, String location, List<TypeItem> results, Set<String> visitedPkgs)
      Recursively collects types within a PSI package using IntelliJ's indexed package hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      pkg - the starting PSI package.
      project - the active project.
      recursive - whether to recurse into subpackages.
      filterKindUpper - optional uppercase element kind filter.
      location - optional origin location filter.
      results - the accumulating result list.
      visitedPkgs - set of visited package FQNs to guard against circular package graphs.
